Restaurants

Visit our restaurants across campus for a variety of a la carte dining options to fit your needs, whether you’re looking for a quick takeout option, a cafe experience or something in between.

Logo

Chick-fil-A – Texas Union

Short Description

Find chicken sandwiches, waffle fries and more at this Texas Union location of the international chain.

Logo

Chick-fil-A – WCP

Short Description

Find chicken sandwiches, waffle fries and more at this WCP Student Activity Center location of the international chain.

Logo

Cypress Bend Cafe

Short Description

Explore this grill and coffee shop all in one located in San Jacinto Residence Hall.

Logo

Jesta' Pizza

Short Description

Build your own pizza with an array of sauces and toppings and find other quick bites on the south side of campus inside Jester Center.

Logo

La Fonda

Short Description

Find breakfast tacos, chilaquiles, tortas, signature dishes and more at this food truck conveniently located on 21st and Speedway.

Logo

Littlefield Patio Cafe

Short Description

Discover bistro-style dining, grab and go offerings and coffee options on the northwest side of campus, adjacent to Littlefield Hall.

Logo

Noodle Lab

Short Description

Stop by the Texas Union to customize your own self-serve bowl of ramen with a variety of ingredients and flavors.

Logo

One Two Three Sushi

Short Description

Stop by the WCP Student Activity Center for customizable sushi and other made-to-order Japanese specials.

Logo

Panda Express

Short Description

Find American Chinese food fresh from the wok at this Texas Union location of the international chain.

Logo

Sabor Tacos y Más

Short Description

Find an assortment of build your own Tex-Mex options off Speedway at the WCP Student Activity Center.

Logo

Tower Burgers and Fries

Short Description

Check out burger, side and beverage options on the west side of campus inside the Texas Union.
